summary: Shasta-Trinity groundhouse lookout, staffed until 1978, restored in 1994, and rented to the public since 1995.

facts.status_note: Restored 1994; kept in reserve by the Forest Service for extreme fire danger.

access.note: Rental cabin; reservation required, no walk-ins; renter picks up lock combination from McCloud Ranger District in advance.

visit.trail_note: Last 4 miles are unpaved and difficult for RVs/trailers.

events.note: NHLR gives 1940 as the build year.

evidence.supports: Build year, design, restoration, staffing end, rental opening.
evidence.quote: Constructed on the Shasta-Trinity National Forest in 1940, Little Mount Hoffman Lookout was restored in 1994. It is a R-5/R-1 groundhouse with a catwalk. In active service until 1978 it was placed in the cabin rental program in 1995.

evidence.supports: 1920s construction claim and continued reserve use.
evidence.quote: Little Mt. Hoffman Lookout was constructed in the 1920s and was used by the Forest Service on a regular basis until 1978...The lookout is still used by the Forest Service in times of extreme fire danger.

evidence.supports: NRHP eligibility and rarity among surviving lookouts.
evidence.quote: It is one of the few remaining historic lookouts in the Shasta-Trinity National Forest and is eligible for listing on the National Register of Historic Places.
In order to access the lookout, renter must obtain combination for the lock at the McCloud District Office between 8 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. or call (530) 964-2184 a week prior to arrival.
Elevation 7,260 ft (2,213 m) ... Date Registered March 2, 1998

evidence.supports: Mountaintop remaining open to the public while renters occupy the lookout.
evidence.quote: The mountain top and area surrounding the lookout is open to the public; renters have sole use of the lookout building.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR states the lookout was built in 1940; Recreation.gov instead says it was constructed in the 1920s. No source consulted explains the gap, so the story reports both figures rather than picking one.

notes_for_editor: Build-year conflict (1940 NHLR vs 1920s Recreation.gov) is unresolved; a primary USFS historic-structures record would help settle it. The californialookouts.weebly.com source did not return page-specific content for this lookout (returned only a sitewide county directory) so it wasn't used.
